collected_cash_gates.AUTHORIZATION: buyer charge approved or a public USD offer exists; not bank cash
collected_cash_gates.SETTLEMENT: processor balance available; Stripe US public default T+2 after capture
collected_cash_gates.BANK_AVAILABLE: funds left the processor for a privately connected payout destination
collected_cash_gates.needs_bryce: payout destination connected inside an official provider UI; no financial data on public roads
collected_cash_gates.note: Authorization is not settlement is not bank-available cash. Banking setup is not the only blocker.

founder_slot.scarce_resource: Bryce calendar / closed-room White Box delivery
founder_slot.collision_rule: only one HIGH founder-slot lane may be ACTIVE in a horizon; others stay ranked and un-erased

lanes.name: high-ticket White Box
lanes.buyer: organization with one legally controlled GGUF family and a runnable evaluation harness
lanes.channel: commercial.html public interest form to OFFER; no payment on that page
lanes.acceptance: listed deliverables supplied; ablation and edit reversible; rollback proof; customer harness ran baseline/ablation/edit/rollback
lanes.falsifier: no NDA/SOW, or rollback check fails, or customer harness never runs
owner_private_blockers: payout destination inside official provider UI
customer model stays off public roads

cash_to_bank_timing.authorization: possible on signing milestone once a rail exists
cash_to_bank_timing.settlement: processor T+2 after capture on public Stripe US default
cash_to_bank_timing.bank_available: only after privately connected destination plus settlement

lanes.collected_cash_gate: NOT_LANDED until a USD offer is actually paid and BANK_AVAILABLE is measured

horizons.now: keep the landed $30k / 30d offer public; do not invent a checkout
horizons.10d: one public non-confidential interest post is enough to start a quote; still no collected cash
horizons.30d: one pilot term can complete if a buyer already signed; founder slot is full
horizons.90d: convert a completed pilot into the separately scoped 12-month license conversation
horizons.180d: second family or second org only after first BANK_AVAILABLE
horizons.365d: license renewals; still do not sell the computer
horizons.730d: White Box remains the high-ticket door; marketplace must not replace it

lanes.name: failure packets
lanes.buyer: lab or operator who wants a measured failure packet, not a computer
lanes.channel: public Commons receipts plus a later priced Bazaar offer after payout dest exists
lanes.acceptance: named artifact, SHA-256, search space, and a miss that is FINDER-FAILED never 0
lanes.falsifier: packet with no hash, or a silent zero, or titan/factory bytes included
owner_private_blockers: decision that a packet is a SKU and not a dump of the computer

cash_to_bank_timing.now: packets exist as public measurements; no USD SKU
cash_to_bank_timing.authorization: possible on a small fixed fee after a USD offer exists
cash_to_bank_timing.settlement: same public rail clocks as cash-now leftover

horizons.now: keep publishing measured packets; do not price them until payout dest exists
horizons.10d: one public catalog of already-landed packets with hashes
horizons.30d: first priced packet SKU only after #needs-bryce payout dest
horizons.90d: repeatable packet series; still no titan
horizons.180d: packet library as a paid shelf beside White Box
horizons.365d: packets remain a lane even if White Box is the cash engine
horizons.730d: packets can feed marketplace listings without selling the computer

lanes.name: paid briefings/training
lanes.buyer: team that wants a closed briefing on White Box method without receiving the factory
lanes.channel: OFFER inbox after a public non-confidential ask; closed room under NDA
lanes.acceptance: agenda delivered; no titan/foundry/offsets leave the room; attendee list stays off public roads
lanes.falsifier: briefing that dumps hide-list internals, or no NDA, or founder double-booked with a pilot

cash_to_bank_timing.authorization: possible on booking after a USD offer exists

horizons.now: do not schedule; founder slot is reserved for White Box
horizons.10d: write a public non-confidential briefing outline only
horizons.30d: one briefing only if no live White Box pilot occupies the slot
horizons.90d: recorded training that does not include hide-list material
horizons.180d: repeatable training SKU after first BANK_AVAILABLE
horizons.365d: training can run without a new founder day if materials exist
horizons.730d: training remains a lane; not erased by marketplace

lanes.name: tools/receipts
lanes.buyer: operator who pays for a named receipt or a hosted measurement, not a computer
lanes.channel: existing public tools (commercial.html, bazaar.html, Action Pad) plus later USD offers
lanes.acceptance: durable result path with SHA; payment reference never proves delivery
lanes.falsifier: tool that claims PAID without a delivery receipt, or adds a login gate
owner_private_blockers: decision to list a USD-priced Bazaar offer
lanes.collected_cash_gate: NOT_LANDED — current bazaar offers are price 0

horizons.now: keep tools open-door; do not add auth
horizons.10d: one receipt SKU design that reuses DIO delivery_receipt schema
horizons.30d: priced receipt only after payout dest
horizons.90d: tools remain free to run; receipts can be paid
horizons.365d: tools/receipts still a lane if marketplace exists
horizons.730d: do not erase free tools when paid receipts exist

lanes.name: licensing
lanes.buyer: organization that completed a White Box pilot and wants 12-month internal use
lanes.channel: separately scoped follow-on after a successful pilot; not the public interest form
lanes.acceptance: scope, model-family count, and term written; computer and foundry stay with Bryce
lanes.falsifier: license that transfers the computer, or a license sold before a completed pilot

cash_to_bank_timing.settlement: same rail clocks; larger amount does not skip T+2

lanes.collected_cash_gate: NOT_LANDED — follow-on is separately scoped and after-pilot

horizons.now: keep the published range; do not pretend it is collected
horizons.30d: license talk only after a live pilot is accepted
horizons.90d: first license window after one 30d pilot plus settlement
horizons.730d: license remains the high-dollar follow-on; marketplace does not replace it

lanes.name: retainers
lanes.buyer: org that wants reserved White Box capacity after first BANK_AVAILABLE
lanes.channel: private follow-on; not a public checkout
lanes.acceptance: hours or capacity named; hide list still hidden
lanes.falsifier: retainer that sells unrestricted factory access, or retainer sold before first collected cash

cash_to_bank_timing.authorization: on signing after first collected cash exists

horizons.now: do not offer; collides with the only now-active founder slot
horizons.30d: no retainer unless a pilot already produced BANK_AVAILABLE
horizons.90d: first retainer design after one collected-cash event
horizons.180d: one retainer max; still HIGH founder collision
horizons.365d: retainers only if White Box delivery is repeatable
horizons.730d: keep ranked; do not erase if unused

lanes.name: expert networks
lanes.buyer: network that pays for a bounded expert hour, not the computer
lanes.acceptance: hour delivered; no hide-list dump; no customer data on Commons
lanes.falsifier: network listing that exposes private buyer data or factory internals
owner_private_blockers: owner decision to appear on a network

cash_to_bank_timing.authorization: network pays the expert after the hour
cash_to_bank_timing.bank_available: owner-private; do not publish destination data

horizons.now: do not list Bryce on a network; slot reserved
horizons.180d: possible after first BANK_AVAILABLE if calendar exists

lanes.name: grants
lanes.buyer: grantor / agency / foundation; not a product customer
lanes.channel: owner-private application; no grant text invented here
lanes.acceptance: award letter plus a public non-confidential receipt that names no bank data
lanes.falsifier: grant story with no application, or an application that publishes hide-list material

cash_to_bank_timing.settlement: grantor disbursement clock, often 30–90d after award

horizons.now: do not file from this session
horizons.365d: first plausible BANK_AVAILABLE if an award exists
horizons.730d: keep ranked; slow cash-to-bank is why this is not now

lanes.name: sponsorships/partners
lanes.buyer: partner who wants public association without receiving the computer
lanes.channel: public non-confidential OFFER post; no outreach from this leftover
lanes.acceptance: written scope that forbids factory transfer and private buyer data on Commons
lanes.falsifier: partner deal that requires auth on Commons, or that publishes hide-list material
owner_private_blockers: no private buyer list on the board

cash_to_bank_timing.settlement: same rail clocks if paid via a public processor

horizons.30d: public page already states the offer; that is enough
horizons.90d: partner talk only after first collected cash or a live pilot
horizons.180d: possible co-branded briefing that still hides the factory

lanes.name: later marketplace paths
lanes.buyer: later buyer of a mind/file/receipt that is not the computer
lanes.channel: bazaar.html / later marketplace; first catalog currency is FREE_COLONY_COMPUTE
lanes.acceptance: copy-the-file is not a sale of the computer; paid SKU must be a keepable mind/receipt/appliance-without-foundry
lanes.falsifier: marketplace listing of titan, foundry, allocator, live offsets, or commons.mno smash
owner_private_blockers: product law: computer is not the product
first collected cash on an earlier lane

cash_to_bank_timing.authorization: only after a real USD SKU exists

horizons.now: do not open a marketplace checkout
horizons.90d: design a non-computer SKU only after payout dest exists
horizons.180d: optional pocket-mind / receipt SKU, never the factory
horizons.365d: marketplace may exist beside White Box
horizons.730d: marketplace is a lane, not a replacement; do not erase
